title: BlackRock to Acquire SulAmérica Investimentos, Expanding Investment Capabilities in Brazil
summary: Acquisition to bring together complementary local and global capabilities to broaden investment solutions for clients in Brazil.
body_markdown:
*Acquisition to bring together complementary local and global capabilities to broaden investment solutions for clients in Brazil*


**SÃO PAULO and NEW YORK – 18 November 2026** - BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE: BLK) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire SulAmérica Investimentos, a Brazilian asset management group with approximately $17 billion in total assets under management,1 established local investment capabilities and deep relationships across Brazil's wealth and pension sectors.


SulAmérica Investimentos brings an experienced local investment team, more than 25 distribution agreements across Brazil's wealth sector and relationships with approximately 200 of the country's leading pension funds. The combination will bring together these capabilities and relationships with BlackRock's global investment platform, technology and broad product offering. Upon closing, it will expand BlackRock's investment capabilities and distribution relationships in Brazil, giving clients more investment choices to help them meet their long-term goals.


Brazil has one of the world's largest asset management industries, with approximately $2 trillion in managed assets today2, expected to reach $3 trillion by 2030.3 Open architecture, the shift toward fee-based advice and growing ETF adoption are expanding investment choice and changing how portfolios are built. Together, these trends are creating new opportunities to better serve clients across all segments in Brazil.


BlackRock has served clients in Brazil since 2008, offering ETFs, international investments and investment technology.


“Being Brazilian in Brazil means understanding our clients' local needs and bringing the strengths of our global platform to meet them where they are. This combination builds on the business we have developed here since 2008 and reflects our long-term confidence in Brazil,” said **Armando Senra, Head of Americas Institutional Business and BlackRock’s Business in Canada and Latin America** . “SulAmérica Investimentos has built an established local investment offering and strong client relationships that will add to the business we have already built in Brazil. By bringing together the strengths of both businesses, we can develop new investment solutions, give clients more choices and help them meet their long-term goals.”


Following closing, the combination is expected to create opportunities to develop new investment solutions for clients in Brazil and bring Brazilian investment expertise to clients in other countries.


“Over the years, SulAmérica Investimentos has built a reputation anchored in investment expertise, disciplined management, and enduring client relationships. This transaction brings together complementary talent, products, technology, and global reach to deliver a broader suite of solutions, without losing the personalized service that made us a top player in the fast-evolving asset management business in Brazil,” added **Marcelo Mello, CEO for SulAmérica Investimentos** .


The transaction is expected to close next year, subject to applicable regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions. BlackRock and SulAmérica Investimentos will continue to operate independently until closing.


## About BlackRock


BlackRock’s purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being. As a fiduciary to investors and a leading provider of financial technology, we help millions of people build savings that serve them throughout their lives by making investing easier and more affordable. For additional information on BlackRock, please visit[www.blackrock.com/corporate](https://www.blackrock.com/corporate)


## About SulAmérica Investimentos


Founded in 1996, SulAmérica Investimentos is a Brazilian investment management firm serving institutional and individual investors. Its investment capabilities include fixed income, private credit, equities and multi-asset strategies. The firm has established long-term relationships with pension funds, financial institutions, family offices and investment distribution platforms.
